style="text;html=0;whiteSpace=wrap;overflow=hidden;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontFamily=Helvetica Neue;fontSize=16;fontColor=#1A1B1C;fontStyle=1;spacing=0;" value="API contract (from controllers + test suite)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="26" width="697" x="72" y="862" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="c35" parent="1" style="text;html=0;whiteSpace=wrap;overflow=hidden;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontFamily=Helvetica Neue;fontSize=14;fontColor=#1A1B1C;fontStyle=0;spacing=0;" value="Public: POST /auth/login → 200 {token} | 401 empty body. GET /health → 200 {status: UP}.
Authenticated (any role): GET /api/hello (Bearer required), GET /customers, GET /customers/{id},
GET /customers/search?firstName= and /search/job?jobTitle= (exact match) → 200 | 404.
ADMIN only: POST /customers → 201, PUT /customers/{id} → 200, DELETE /customers/{id} → 204,
POST /customers/{id}/interactions → 201. Other roles → 403. Invalid body → 400.
Unknown id → 404 {message, timestamp}. Customer payload: id, firstName, lastName, email,
contactNo, jobTitle, yearOfBirth. Interaction payload: id, remarks, interactionDate, customer." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="250" width="697" x="72" y="891" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="c36" parent="1" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=0;fillColor=#F0F0C0;strokeColor=#1A1B1C;strokeWidth=1.5;dashed=0;fontColor=#1A1B1C;fontFamily=Helvetica Neue;fontSize=16;spacing=12;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="205" width="727" x="825" y="845" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="c37" parent="1" style="text;html=0;whiteSpace=wrap;overflow=hidden;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontFamily=Helvetica Neue;fontSize=16;fontColor=#1A1B1C;fontStyle=1;spacing=0;" value="Runtime configuration and scope" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="26" width="679" x="849" y="862" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="c38" parent="1" style="text;html=0;whiteSpace=wrap;overflow=hidden;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontFamily=Helvetica Neue;fontSize=14;fontColor=#1A1B1C;fontStyle=0;spacing=0;" value="Dev profile: port 8080 · jdbc:postgresql://localhost:5432/simple_crm · ddl-auto=create.
spring.config.import=optional:file:.env — JWT secret and app.auth.* login credentials.
Token lifetime 3,600,000 ms (1 h). Basic users are separate from login credentials.
Tests use H2 in-memory (crm-tests, create-drop). Prod profile is a port-only stub (8081).
Student / Course entities and CourseRepository exist but are unused by the service layer.
No frontend, no external identity provider, no deployment automation." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="155" width="679" x="849" y="891" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="c39" parent="1" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=0;fillColor=#F4D7D7;strokeColor=#1A1B1C;strokeWidth=1.5;dashed=0;fontColor=#1A1B1C;fontFamily=Helvetica Neue;fontSize=16;spacing=12;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="95" width="727" x="825" y="1070" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="c40" parent="1" style="text;html=0;whiteSpace=wrap;overflow=hidden;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontFamily=Helvetica Neue;fontSize=16;fontColor=#1A1B1C;fontStyle=1;spacing=0;" value="Development startup resets data" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="26" width="679" x="849" y="1087" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="c41" parent="1" style="text;html=0;whiteSpace=wrap;overflow=hidden;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontFamily=Helvetica Neue;fontSize=14;fontColor=#1A1B1C;fontStyle=0;spacing=0;" value="Hibernate ddl-auto=create recreates tables. DataLoader then deletes customers and inserts four
examples. No cascade delete exists for customer → interaction." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="45" width="679" x="849" y="1116" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="c42" edge="1" parent="1" style="edgeStyle=none;rounded=0;html=0;strokeColor=#555555;strokeWidth=1.5;dashed=0;endArrow=none;endFill=1;"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="48" y="1178" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="1552" y="1178" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="c43" parent="1" style="text;html=0;whiteSpace=wrap;overflow=hidden;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontFamily=Helvetica Neue;fontSize=14;fontColor=#1A1B1C;fontStyle=0;spacing=0;" value="Solid arrows show requests or dependencies. Dashed boundary marks the application process. Replies are omitted in this view." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="40" width="1504" x="48" y="1193" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

div.div:
Public: POST /auth/login → 200 {token} | 401 empty body. GET /health → 200 {status: UP}.
Authenticated (any role): GET /api/hello (Bearer required), GET /customers, GET /customers/{id},
GET /customers/search?firstName= and /search/job?jobTitle= (exact match) → 200 | 404.
ADMIN only: POST /customers → 201, PUT /customers/{id} → 200, DELETE /customers/{id} → 204,
POST /customers/{id}/interactions → 201. Other roles → 403. Invalid body → 400.
Unknown id → 404 {message, timestamp}. Customer payload: id, firstName, lastName, email,
contactNo, jobTitle, yearOfBirth. Interaction payload: id, remarks, interactionDate, customer.

div.div:
Dev profile: port 8080 · jdbc:postgresql://localhost:5432/simple_crm · ddl-auto=create.
spring.config.import=optional:file:.env — JWT secret and app.auth.* login credentials.
Token lifetime 3,600,000 ms (1 h). Basic users are separate from login credentials.
Tests use H2 in-memory (crm-tests, create-drop). Prod profile is a port-only stub (8081).
Student / Course entities and CourseRepository exist but are unused by the service layer.
No frontend, no external identity provider, no deployment automation.

Hibernate ddl-auto=create recreates tables. DataLoader then deletes customers and inserts four
examples. No cascade delete exists for customer → interaction.
